definitions.cross_fidelity_error: mean over TA/TV/AV/TAV of abs(student interaction - teacher interaction)
definitions.delta_cross_fidelity: Full KD cross-modal fidelity error - Uniform cross-modal fidelity error; positive favors Uniform
definitions.overall_fidelity_error_auxiliary: mean over all seven coordinates of abs(student interaction - teacher interaction)
definitions.delta_task_error: Full KD task error - Uniform task error; positive favors Uniform
definitions.task_prediction_source: stored TAV output from the same all-seven-subset validation forward used for interaction reconstruction

polarity_outcomes.protocol: Acc-2 non-zero; true positive iff target > 0; predicted positive iff regression prediction >= 0
